endpoint_bounds.derivation: Fixed XY at T forces |delta_i-delta_j+baseline_dz| >= V. Triangle inequality gives |delta_i|+|delta_j| >= V-|baseline_dz| and max >= (V-|baseline_dz|)/2. Sum only disjoint pairs.
